abilities.descEn:
Rangers will have a high chance of being revived when they are defeated.
Rangers will be revived with 70% HP. This Ability will only activate once.
abilities.descZh:
Ranger被打倒時將能以高機率復活。
能力發動後將以70%體力的狀態復活，且無法再次發動該能力。

abilities.descEn: Fixed chance of ignoring a Wood element enemy's Skill Resistance when attacking.
abilities.descZh: 攻擊時以一定機率無視木屬性敵人的技能抗性。

abilities.descEn: Frequently avoids the effects of Ice Shot and Blizzard items.
abilities.descZh: 該Ranger能夠以高機率閃避「發射冰／暴風雪」的道具效果。
